section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Planetary Gear Output Shaft)

content.description: Installing oil seal rings on output shaft by hand

content.text: 5. INSTALL THREE OIL SEAL RINGS ON OUTPUT SHAFT
Spread the rings apart and slide them into the groove. Hook both ends by hand.
6. INSTALL THRUST BEARING AND RACE ON OUTPUT SHAFT
Hold the cup of the race toward the bearing.
7. USE EXTENSION HOUSING AS ASSEMBLY STAND

content.description: Using extension housing as assembly stand with intermediate shaft assembly being installed

content.text: 8. INSTALL INTERMEDIATE SHAFT ASSEMBLY IN OUTPUT SHAFT
9. INSTALL REAR PLANETARY CARRIER IN OUTPUT SHAFT
Slide the carrier into place, and make sure that the lugs interlock.

content.description: Setting front planetary ring gear with snap ring alignment

content.text: 10. SET IN PLACE FRONT PLANETARY RING GEAR
Slide the snap ring downward, and align the lugs with the notches.
Align the ends of the snap ring with the wide gap between the teeth.
11. INSTALL FRONT PLANETARY RING GEAR WITH SNAP RING
While pushing down the ring gear, squeeze the snap ring end with snap ring pliers and install it into the groove.
NOTE: When the snap ring is fully seated, the gap is the width of one lug.

content.description: Installing nylon thrust washer in front planetary pinion gear

content.text: 12. INSTALL NYLON THRUST WASHER IN FRONT PLANETARY PINION GEAR
Face the lugs downward and match them with the slots in back of the planetary gear.

content.description: Installing one-way clutch showing front orientation and spring cage toward front

content.text: Install the one-way clutch into the outer race, facing the spring cage toward the front.
